The project

Vilna OS, Gloxi and Herkos are free software. Their code is in a public repository under GPL-3.0-or-later or Apache-2.0; each file says which. The code and text of this site are under GPL-3.0-or-later.

Names and logos

The names Vilna OS, Gloxi and Herkos and their logos identify this project. Please do not use them in a way that suggests that your product is ours. Vilna OS is based on openSUSE but is not made or endorsed by the openSUSE Project or SUSE; openSUSE is a trademark of SUSE LLC.

Hosting

This site is hosted by statichost.eu in the EU. Feedback and crash reports go to our own server, reports.vilnaos.com, at IONOS in an EU data centre.

No warranty

Vilna OS and Gloxi are provided as they are, without warranty, as their licences say. Previews are for testing: keep backups of anything important.

Links

This site links to other sites, such as GitHub. We do not control them, and their own terms and privacy policies apply.
